column1: # Cars only openDC has (not in Enhanced Rice): a score from 1 (cheapest) to 10 (most expensive) for the base car,
# by the real car (how rare and wanted it is). The price at the car's V goes from the low to the high end of a range,
# in Rice's steps (V9: normal 1.5M-5.5M in steps of 50,000; specials in steps of 250,000: ST 33.75M-57.5M,
# BT 10M-33.75M, MINI 60M-81.25M, CT 12.5M-17.5M). The special cars (ST / BT / MINI / CT) use their base car's score.
